profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company headquartered in Menlo Park, California, founded in 2004, with 2024 revenue of $200.966 billion. The company describes itself as providing products and solutions for AI developers, offering access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and Meta Model API. Its AI offerings include Llama, an open-weight model family often self-hosted, tuned for long-horizon coding workflows with performance across coding evaluations. Meta Model API also provides search grounding to give models live web access and Muse Image, a reasoning model for image generation, priced at $0.01 per image.

Meta operates multiple MCP servers, including Meta Ads MCP servers with tools for campaign, creative, audience, and insight management, and an AI-in-Research MCP providing read-only access to the LivingMeta corpus of 12,400 papers. Additional integrations include FastMetal for running and comparing LLMs with cost tracking, Primeta for 3D avatars with custom personas, and MetaDock for desktop workspace control.

The company faces three active lawsuits in federal court: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the Northern District of California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. also in the Northern District of California. Meta has substantial legal exposure in California with 220 cases recorded.
